content.comment_body: One of our clients uses a [company_name] [product_name] and we are looking to set up communication between this device and AVEVA / Wonderware System Platform (Archestra), but not via InTouch and using OI SIDIRECT. Has anyone done this before or can offer guidance? I saw someone mention KEPServer as a solution, but we prefer to use OI SIDIRECT. Alternative recommendations are welcome. Thanks in advance.

Hello, I believe Wonderware supports Modbus TCP as well. You should check whether your [product_name] is compatible with Modbus TCP. Any current [product_name] with [version_no] and article number [article_no] supports Modbus TCP. Another option could be S7-communication between Wonderware and [product_name], but I'm not certain whether S7-communication is available in Wonderware. Hope this helps.
